patterns: APPSC asks current-affairs one-liners: IREDA MoU partner (IIT Bhubaneswar), NCEF purpose, India first with a non-conventional energy ministry.
Other PSCs ask ISA secretariat location (Gurugram) - HQ/host-city facts recur.
Expect 'first/host/partner' items (VITO biodiesel at Ayodhya, MI-8 in Goa) rather than capacity statistics.
App MCQs add many 2025-26 capacity figures and targets; PYQs rarely test numbers this granular.
